testRun.output: 26 tests, 0 failures; module compiles on desktop and iosSimulatorArm64.

implementation.summary: ShellToolbar: 52dp chrome bar, bottom hairline, SIX FIXED NAMED SLOTS in canonical order - leading Spacer(ShellWindowDefaults.TrafficLightInset) reserving room for the macOS traffic lights, platformSwitch, deviceIndicator, Spacer(weight 1f), stagedCounter, clearAction, primaryAction. Deliberately not a free-form RowScope, so downstream specs cannot reorder the canonical chrome. ShellStatusBar: 28dp chrome bar, top hairline, leading/trailing RowScope slots either side of Spacer(weight 1f). All content STUBBED per AC-37 - no device logic, no adb/idb import.

reusedFromRegistry.how: Ghost disabled 'Clear'; Primary disabled 'Resolve & Send' using AppButton's own shortcut parameter

authoredNew: ShellToolbar and ShellStatusBar - the two container organisms only. ZERO new leaf components.

troubleshooting.issue: KeyCap was briefed as the Cmd+Enter affordance but is deliberately NOT used: comp 02 shows the glyph as flat muted text inside the button, and AppButton already ships a `shortcut` parameter whose own KDoc example is literally 'Resolve & Send' + the glyph. Using KeyCap would have added a bordered cap the comp does not show.

StatusPill and StatusLine were read and rejected: StatusLine models a multi-step pipeline (Streaming > Frozen > ...) and StatusPill is a seg-filled chip. The status bar needs a bare dot + label, which is exactly StatusIndicator.
Status-bar copy follows comp 02's neutral 'Waiting for device...', NOT comp 01's green 'adb ... ready' - the green dot requires downstream tool detection this spec does not build.
